entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. I'm calling about an order. I have this jersey, and I'm just not sure what to do. I think I need to send it back.
I can certainly help you look into that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's just the wrong size. I finally went to wear it and it's much too tight. I don't understand the policy on the website, it's all a bit confusing.
I understand, no problem at all. So to clarify, it's not a technical fault with the jersey, just a sizing preference?
Yes, that's right. I think I need to exchange it for a larger size. It's just way too tight to be comfortable. Can't you just help me? I'm a bit lost here.
Of course. I just need to pull up your account. Could you please provide your order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the ProFit Jersey here, delivered 68 days ago. Let me just review the policy for you.
Okay, I hope it's not too late.
Good news. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this for you.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. So I can do an exchange?

Yes, you can. I've just approved the return in our system. I am sending you a prepaid return label to your email now. You can use that to send back the jersey, and once we receive it, we can either issue a full refund or send out the new size. What would you prefer?
The exchange for a bigger size would be perfect. Thank you so much, Diana. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
